items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: So I told Lawrence, Christmas evening, the night I was leaving, he brought me here. He brought me home because I had to get ready to go to the station.

ctx.x: Lawrence Dent, yeah. I know him, I see him, he plays in one of the bands, the Gibson band. Is that good clarinet now?

Yeah, that's what Lawrence said. So I told Lawrence, Christmas evening, the night I was leaving, he brought me here. He brought me home because I had to get ready to go to the station. And I told him about Baby being sick and he said that he was thinking he was going to go to Chicago. I said, well he's very little sick. I said, now I wrote him a card and I got an answer from him. I said, but he's very, very little. And so I said, he said, well I'm going to drive up there and see about him. Now I don't know if he…
The Baby lived longer to be older than any of them and also older than any of his sisters too.
